question: **Select the correctly spelt word. **
solution:
The correct answer is '**Maintenance**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Among the given Options, the incorrectly spelt word is '**Maintenance**'.
 
• It means 'keeping something in good condition'. (रख-रखाव)
 
 
• *Example: This house needs a lot of **maintenance**.*
